title: HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB 2026
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: The announcement lists Week 1 at Doi Inthanon National Park Office on 27-29 November 2026 with PAGODA 50 DAY, PAGODA 50 NIGHT, INTHANON 20 and a warm-up run, and Week 2 at Chiang Mai PAO Park on 3-6 December 2026.
The announcement states that PAGODA 50 DAY and PAGODA 50 NIGHT each carry 4 Running Stones.
The same announcement describes the event as '2 full weeks / 12 race formats / 4 iconic Chiang Mai mountains / 38 Stones', but later in the same article says '34 Stones, 11 Races, 1 Chiang Mai'.
The announcement states that the event is a UTMB World Series Major where runners earn double Stones in every race.
